name: First Form: Unknowing Fire
description: The user charges forward at high speed and delivers a powerful horizontal slash.

name: Second Form: Rising Scorching Sun
description: A rising sword slash delivered upward with great force.

name: Third Form: Blazing Universe
description: A powerful downward slash performed with the force and imagery of blazing flame.

name: Fourth Form: Blooming Flame Undulation
description: A defensive technique using sweeping circular sword movements to protect the user.

name: Fifth Form: Flame Tiger
description: A sequence of powerful sword strikes visually resembling a charging flame tiger.

name: Ninth Form: Rengoku
description: A devastating high-speed charge followed by an extremely powerful slash.

name: First Form: Water Surface Slash
description: A powerful horizontal slash performed with a smooth flowing motion.

name: Second Form: Water Wheel
description: The user rotates vertically while delivering a circular sword attack.

name: Third Form: Flowing Dance
description: A series of flowing movements and slashes that allow the user to move smoothly around opponents.

name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide
description: The user performs multiple flowing slashes against one or more targets.

name: Fifth Form: Blessed Rain After the Drought
description: A gentle decapitation technique intended to cause minimal pain to an opponent who willingly accepts defeat.

name: Sixth Form: Whirlpool
description: The user twists their body and sword together to create a powerful circular cutting motion.

name: Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust
description: A fast and precise thrust aimed directly at the opponent.

name: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
description: A powerful downward sword strike resembling the force of a waterfall.

name: Ninth Form: Splashing Water Flow
description: A movement-focused form designed to minimize the user's contact with the ground.

name: Tenth Form: Constant Flux
description: A continuous rotating attack that grows stronger as momentum increases.

name: Eleventh Form: Dead Calm
description: Giyu's personal Water Breathing form, using extremely calm and precise movements to neutralize incoming attacks.

name: Dance
description: A powerful vertical slash performed as part of Hinokami Kagura.

name: Clear Blue Sky
description: The user rotates their body to deliver a circular sword attack.

name: Raging Sun
description: A pair of rapid horizontal slashes used for both offense and defense.

name: Burning Bones, Summer Sun
description: A circular defensive slash used to counter attacks at close range.

name: Setting Sun Transformation
description: The user flips into the air and delivers a powerful downward slash.

name: Solar Heat Haze
description: A fast attack that makes the sword's movement difficult for the opponent to perceive.

name: Beneficent Radiance
description: A spiraling aerial attack performed while moving toward the opponent.

name: Sunflower Thrust
description: A direct thrust performed with the tip of the sword.

name: Dragon Sun Halo Head Dance
description: A continuous sequence of fast slashes resembling a dragon moving around the opponent.

name: Fire Wheel
description: The user moves behind the opponent and performs a spinning vertical attack.

name: Fake Rainbow
description: A high-speed evasive movement that creates the impression of an afterimage.

name: Flame Dance
description: A two-part attack combining a vertical slash with an immediate horizontal strike.

name: Butterfly Dance: Caprice
description: Shinobu rapidly moves around the opponent and delivers multiple poison-infused thrusts.

name: Dance of the Bee Sting: True Flutter
description: A high-speed thrust aimed at injecting poison into the opponent.

name: Dance of the Dragonfly: Compound Eye Hexagon
description: A rapid series of precise thrusts aimed at multiple vulnerable points.

name: Dance of the Centipede: Hundred-Legged Zigzag
description: An unpredictable zigzagging charge that builds speed before a powerful thrust.

name: Compass Needle
description: Akaza creates a compass-like field that helps him sense an opponent's fighting spirit and predict attacks.

name: Air Type
description: Akaza strikes the air and creates powerful long-range shockwaves.

name: Disorder
description: A rapid barrage of powerful punches that produces destructive shockwaves.

name: Annihilation Type
description: One of Akaza's strongest close-range attacks, concentrating enormous force into a devastating strike.

name: Blue Silver Chaotic Afterglow
description: Akaza unleashes a large number of high-speed attacks and shockwaves across the surrounding area.

name: Frozen Lotuses
description: Doma generates razor-sharp formations of ice shaped like lotus flowers.

name: Barren Hanging Garden
description: Doma produces large quantities of frozen structures to attack and restrict opponents.

name: Freezing Clouds
description: Doma releases freezing mist capable of damaging anyone who inhales or comes into contact with it.

name: Cold White Princesses
description: Doma creates icy humanoid figures that release freezing air toward opponents.

name: Rime — Water Lily Bodhisattva
description: Doma creates an enormous ice construct capable of launching powerful freezing attacks.

name: Exploding Blood
description: Nezuko ignites her own blood into supernatural flames that damage demons while generally leaving humans unharmed.
